meaning:
μακαρζω
(μακάριος), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pi., pu. ;]
to bless, pronounce blessed or happy: with accusative of person(s), Luk.1:48, Jas.5:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
